fn name, {drinks, current} ->
      case Inventory.reserve(current, name) do
        {:ok, next} -> {[name | drinks], next}
        {:error, reason} ->
          unless reason == :unknown, do: Logger.info("sold out: #{name}")
          {drinks, current}
      end
    end

nodes.signature:
fn {name, count}, current ->
      normalize = fn value -> max(adjust.(value), 0) end
      beans = Map.update(current.beans, name, normalize.(count), fn previous ->
        previous + normalize.(count)
      end)
      %{current | beans: beans}
    end
